headline: OKX Bitcoin Long-Short Account Ratio Rises To 2.26 From 2.14 As The 30-Day Rank Hits 99.3
narrative: The bitcoin long-short account ratio on OKX rose to 2.26 from 2.14, and the 30-day rank rose to 99.3 from 91.1. The ratio counts long accounts against short accounts on that venue, and the rank is the share of hourly readings over the last 30 days below the current print, so the account mix is more long than on 99.3 percent of those hours, against a 30-day high of 2.28 and a low of 0.97. Ether account ratio is 2.69 at the 94.3 percentile and Solana is 2.92 at the 91.1 percentile, the same crowded-long reading on that pipe.
author: jordan
